create.name: Samantha Cooper
create.bio:
Samantha Cooper, known online as Mindful Medium Mandy, is an evidential medium, Reiki master and teacher of intuitive development based in San Diego, California, where she works under the name 108 Mindfully Made. She has trained with British Spiritualist mediums including Eileen Davies and Andy Byng, and her years as a registered nurse, caring for people and families at difficult moments, shape the steady, respectful way she sits with clients. She is also an ordained interfaith minister and a keen paranormal investigator who likes to keep an open mind and a sceptical one at the same time.

In a reading she aims to bring through concrete details that let a client recognise a loved one who has died, while being clear that no particular contact can be promised. Much of her work is teaching: one-to-one intuitive development sessions, an eight-week Embodied Spirit mentorship covering spirit guides, psychic protection, meditation and ethics, Usui Reiki training at levels one and two, and a monthly development circle in La Mesa where students practise on each other and get honest feedback. She also runs online group readings and shares meditations and mediumship talks on her YouTube channel and on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Evidential mediumship and intuitive development sessions
courses.description: Private sessions online or in person: evidential mediumship readings that seek recognisable details from loved ones who have died, one-to-one intuitive development coaching, and tarot sessions used for reflection.

courses.title: Embodied Spirit Intuitive Mentorship
courses.description: An eight-week small-group mentorship with weekly Zoom calls and support in between, covering how you connect with spirit, psychic protection, meditation basics, guides and ancestors, the aura and the ethics of divination.

courses.title: Intuitive Reiki Training (Level I & II)
courses.description: One-to-one Usui Reiki training at levels one and two over about four weeks, with two long sessions and two follow-up calls. It covers the principles, history and symbols, hand positions, distance practice and attunement, with a certificate at the end.

courses.title: Intuitive Development Circle (La Mesa)
courses.description: A small monthly in-person circle in La Mesa, San Diego County, where beginners and developing mediums practise linking with spirit, strengthen their senses and get constructive feedback.

courses.title: A Night of Spirit Messages: online group reading
courses.description: A Zoom circle for ten to twelve people that opens with a short grounding meditation and a group card pull before messages from spirit are shared.

free_resources.title: Samantha Cooper on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations from Samantha, free to listen to in the app or online.
